title: The Sanctuary Ship
logline: A drifting freighter has declared itself a religious sanctuary, but a brutal debt collector is demanding the pilot help drag a fugitive out of it.

roles.description: Maintains the aging life support of the sanctuary, deeply protective of their flock.
Fled to the sanctuary to escape massive debts, terrified to leave.
A massive, unarmed cargo hauler converted into a sprawling temple.
A heavy, aggressive corporate recovery vessel.

public_situation: The {role:sanctuary_freighter} sits in orbit, refusing to hand over anyone who has claimed religious asylum.
private_truth: The sanctuary's life support is failing, and they are holding the merchant hostage until the merchant's family pays a 'donation' to fix it.

beats.public_change: The debt collector ship locks tractor beams onto the sanctuary freighter.

missions.reason: The engineer begs the pilot to attack the collector ship and force it to break the tractor beam.
missions.private_fact: The engineer knows the sanctuary will tear apart if dragged.

beats.public_change: The sanctuary sends out a desperate distress call for parts.

missions.reason: The merchant secretly hires the pilot to smuggle in a military-grade hyperdrive override chip.
missions.private_fact: The merchant plans to install it in their own impounded ship and punch through the sanctuary's sealed docking bay to escape.

beats.public_change: The collector ship prepares to fire on the sanctuary.

missions.reason: The engineer pays the pilot to destroy the collector ship for good.
missions.private_fact: The collector hails the pilot, offering to pay off the pilot's own debts if they hand over the merchant instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the collector ship.
resolutions.summary: The sanctuary remains safe, but its dark secret holds. The merchant is trapped there forever, paying off the engineer's 'donations'.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended the great temple ship from corporate repo men.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the collector's offer.
resolutions.summary: The merchant is dragged away to a debtor's prison. The sanctuary uses the ensuing outrage to raise more funds.
The collector ship tears the sanctuary apart trying to tow it. Hundreds die, including the merchant.

loose_threads.detail: The debt collector's warrant was backdated by three months, stamped by a judge who was already dead.
The sanctuary's 'donation' accounts empty daily into an untraceable offshore shell company.

radio_hooks: Corporate repo ship attempts to tow {role:sanctuary_freighter}; standoff ensues.
Is the great temple ship a sanctuary or a prison? Editorial at 6.

voice_direction.sanctuary_engineer: Calm, self-righteous, speaks of extortion as if it were a spiritual duty.
voice_direction.hunted_merchant: Panicked, constantly looking over their shoulder, speaks quietly.
